Connecting actions

When cuts in. While keeps rolling.

11
LINK

WHILE

introduces a longer action

While I was filming, my friend was posing.

Often connects two actions in progress.

WHEN

often introduces the interruption

I was filming when the bottle burst.

It can come first or in the middle.

Reading - point 9 activity

The cafeteria camera incident

16
READ

Incident Report 12B

At 12:40 yesterday, the film club was recording a scene in the cafeteria. Sami was carrying a lunch tray across the room. Near the window, Nora and Alex were discussing the next shot. An orange was lying beside their table.

While they were talking, the orange rolled into the aisle. Sami stepped near it and began to wobble. At the same moment, Leo opened a fizzy bottle. Foam shot into the air, and everyone turned to look.

Luckily, Alex caught the tray while napkins were flying around him. The camera recorded everything. Nobody was hurt, the lunch stayed on the tray, and the club decided to keep the accidental scene in its comedy.

Underline: 4 ongoing actions + 4 short events. Then retell without reading.

Pair work - information gap

Do not show your camera card

19
PAIR

Camera A

Background: Two students were decorating a cake.
Interruption: A balloon burst.
Reaction: One student dropped the spoon.

Ask Camera B for missing details. Reconstruct one full story together.

Camera B

Background: The teacher was filming.
Interruption: The spoon landed in a hat.
Ending: Everyone started laughing.

Answer only in complete sentences. Then swap cards.
